slug: 2025-07-23 Review of the Comoros Data Protection Law

facts.fact: TechHive Advisory states the Union of Comoros enacted its Protection of Personal Data Law on 29 June 2021 as a comprehensive framework; it does not say whether the law has commenced.
TechHive Advisory states the law establishes a National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data but that as of mid-2024 it had not been formally constituted or made operational.

facts.fact: Loi n°14-029/AU on protection of personal data (68 articles) was deliberated and adopted by the Assembly in plenary session on 26 June 2014; the text carries no promulgation date or decree.
facts.system: Loi n°14-029/AU portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: Article 19 of the law institutes a Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés (CNIL) whose nine members are named by decree under Article 24; the text records no appointment.

facts.fact: The African Union's status list of 2 February 2026 records that Comoros signed the Malabo Convention on 2018-01-29 and had not ratified it.
